Julien Castellan
Solutions Architect — Cloud & Healthcare Systems Integration
Profile
Solutions architect with 9 years of experience designing secure, scalable systems for regulated sectors, with
a focus on healthcare data platforms and government API integrations. Strong background in role-based
access control, encryption standards, and offline-capable mobile architectures.
Relevant Experience
Solutions Architect — Ministry of Health Patient Referral Platform (2022–2024)
l
Designed the system architecture and data model for a referral-tracking platform used by 500+ field
agents.
l
Built an integration layer to a national health information exchange API, handling authentication, data
mapping, and audit logging.
l
Defined the encryption-at-rest and in-transit standards later validated by an independent security audit.
Technical Architect — Offline-First Field Data Collection App (2020–2021)
l
Architected an offline-capable Android/iOS data collection app with conflict-free sync for low-connectivity
rural deployments.
Technical Skills
l
Architecture: microservices, REST/GraphQL API design, event-driven systems
l
Security: OAuth2/OIDC, encryption standards, role-based access control
l
Mobile: offline-first sync architectures (Android/iOS)
Education
M.Eng. in Computer Science
